name: AKB1/149 Ren'ai Sousenkyo
source:
The ban on romance is lifted once again. And this time, the stakes are higher than ever, all the pretty girls in Japan are vying for your attention. Choose your girl from 149, they come from AKB48, SKE48, NMB48 and HKT48. Find 1 and reject all the other 148. May the goddess of romance smile on you. 

As the third game in the AKB series, everything is new, from the voice clips, photos, movies to the scenarios. To those of you who adore Maeda Atsuko, the eternal center girl in AKB48, this might be the last time you strike up a romance with her, as she is graduating from the group. 

When the girl falls in love with you, you will be treated to the Kami Kokuhaku scenario. A special scene where she confesses her love to you. Unlock this for all 149 girls.

[taken from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/AKB1149_Renai_Sousenkyo/paOS-13-71-1ab-49-en-70-58qj.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
恋爱禁令再次解除。这一次，赌注比以往任何时候都更高，所有日本漂亮女孩都在争夺你的注意力。从149名女孩中选择你的女孩，她们来自AKB48、SKE48、NMB48和HKT48。找到1个，拒绝所有其他148个。愿浪漫女神对你微笑。

作为AKB系列的第三款游戏，从语音、照片、影片到场景，一切都是新的。对于那些喜欢AKB48永恒的中心女孩前田敦子的人来说，这可能是你最后一次与她谈恋爱，因为她即将从组合中毕业。

当女孩爱上你时，你会遇到神国白场景。她向你表白她的爱的特殊场景。为所有149名女孩解锁此功能。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/AKB1149_Renai_Sousenkyo/paOS-13-71-1ab-49-en-70-58qj.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
